issues.problem: The results are numerically coherent, and L. lactis growth at a 10 °C excursion is not inherently impossible, but the summary omits starting inoculum, total storage duration and excursion duration. Consequently its large endpoint-positive fraction cannot be independently assessed as a growth experiment. This is not evidence that the reported classification counts are impossible.
issues.fix: Add after the endpoint definition: “This report summary does not specify starting inoculum, total storage duration or excursion duration; its end-point classification results therefore do not establish a growth rate or time to threshold.” Record that limitation in F25. A reviser may instead supply an internally consistent fictional schedule, but should not infer one from the existing counts.
